containerOverrides.name: migrate
command: import pg from 'pg'; import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { createPoolConfig } from './apps/server/dist/db/client.config.js'; const pool = new pg.Pool(createPoolConfig(process.env.DATABASE_URL, 'production', readFileSync(process.env.RDS_CA_BUNDLE, 'utf8'), 1)); const client = await pool.connect(); try { await client.query('BEGIN READ ONLY'); const result = await client.query("select (select count(*)::int from public.subjects) as subjects, (select count(*)::int from public.subject_variants) as variants, (select count(*)::int from public.users) as users, (select count(*)::int from public.users where cognito_sub like 'mock-%' or email like '%@tutorpair.local') as mock_users"); console.log(JSON.stringify(result.rows[0])); await client.query('COMMIT'); } catch (error) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); throw error; } finally { client.release(); await pool.end(); }
